verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs show native windows, tabs and panes as built-in features. Multiple agent conversations can run across windows, tabs or panes, session restoration brings back windows, tabs and panes on relaunch, pane behavior is configurable, and vertical tabs are built in. Together these show splitting and tab organization without tmux or another external multiplexer. Missing for 10: a dedicated doc on how to split and navigate panes (keybindings, layouts), explicit framing as a replacement for an external multiplexer, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the pane and tab workflow.
